highlights.zh: 建立文件索引时自动保存图片和视频分辨率；相册没有缩略图时，先按原始媒体比例显示占位，升级旧库只补空列，不扫描文件。
highlights.en: File indexing now saves image and video dimensions. Albums without thumbnails use the original media aspect ratio for placeholders, and existing databases receive empty columns without file scans.

highlights.zh: 文件移动、改名、永久删除、移入和移出回收站统一走同一套生命周期管理，主索引、查重关系和人脸数据在同一个数据库事务内同步更新。
highlights.en: File moves, renames, permanent deletion, recycling, and restoration now share one lifecycle manager, updating file, duplicate, and face indexes in a single database transaction.

highlights.zh: 回收站文件不再出现在相册、文件管理和查重结果中，但保留查重关系与人脸特征；恢复后重新可见，无需重新识别人脸。
highlights.en: Recycled files are hidden from albums, file management, and duplicate results while their duplicate links and face data are preserved. Restoring makes them visible again without rerunning face recognition.

highlights.zh: 永久删除会同步清理文件索引、查重关系和人脸数据；多个文件共用缩略图时，只有最后一个引用被删除才删除缩略图。
highlights.en: Permanent deletion now cleans file, duplicate, and face indexes together. Shared thumbnails are removed only after their last referencing file is deleted.

highlights.zh: 移动文件后若数据库更新失败，会尝试把文件移回原位置；批量索引更新采用分批处理，并兼容 Windows 路径大小写差异。
highlights.en: If a database update fails after a file move, the system attempts to move the file back. Batch index updates are chunked and handle Windows path case differences.

rebuild_index_notice.zh: 本次升级无需重建索引。已有图片或视频缺少分辨率时，可在建立文件索引页面点击“补全缺少信息”；旧库升级不会自动扫描文件。
rebuild_index_notice.en: No index rebuild is required. For existing images or videos missing dimensions, use “Fill Missing Information” on the file indexing page; upgrading an older database does not trigger file scans.

highlights.zh: 相册设置新增“缩略图管理”，生成缩略图、清理无效缩略图和清空缩略图三个按钮排列在同一行，尺寸一致。
highlights.en: Album Settings now has Thumbnail Management, with Generate Thumbnails, Clean Invalid Thumbnails, and Clear Thumbnails aligned in one row at a consistent size.

highlights.zh: 清空缩略图前会再次确认，只有系统管理员或当前仓库管理员可以操作；清空会停止生成队列，但不会影响原始图片和视频。
highlights.en: Clearing thumbnails requires confirmation and is restricted to system or repository administrators. It stops thumbnail generation without affecting original images or videos.

highlights.zh: 修复点击相册年份、月份或日期后仍回到原位置的问题，向上滚动补加载上一批内容时也会保持当前画面不跳动。
highlights.en: Fixed album year, month, and date navigation returning to the original position, and kept the current view stable when loading a previous batch upward.

highlights.zh: 文件名排序下的字母尺将“#”放在第一位，方便快速定位以数字或符号开头的文件名。
highlights.en: The alphabet ruler now places “#” first when sorting by filename, making names beginning with numbers or symbols easier to find.

highlights.zh: 修复当前任务按钮在有任务时动画反复重启、显示异常的问题，亮色和暗色主题下都能持续平稳转动。
highlights.en: Fixed the Current Tasks icon repeatedly restarting or displaying incorrectly while tasks were running; it now rotates smoothly in light and dark themes.

rebuild_index_notice.zh: 本次升级无需重建索引。清空缩略图后，再次浏览图片或视频时会按需重新生成，也可以使用“生成缩略图”提前补齐。
rebuild_index_notice.en: No index rebuild is required. After clearing thumbnails, they are regenerated on demand when you browse images or videos, or you can use Generate Thumbnails to prepare them in advance.

highlights.zh: 相册改为横向填满再换行的瀑布流，支持 1 到 10 列和每批 50 到 500 条，未加载时显示圆形占位，翻页自动衔接。
highlights.en: The album now uses a row-filled waterfall layout with 1–10 columns and 50–500 items per batch, circular loading placeholders, and seamless cursor-based paging.

highlights.zh: 相册新增总数、完整字母尺和分级年月日时间轴，可按年份、月份、日期定位，并在向上滚动时加载上一批内容。
highlights.en: Added album totals, a complete alphabet ruler, and hierarchical year/month/day timelines with date navigation and previous-batch loading when scrolling upward.

highlights.zh: 相册时间轴和字母尺放在可折叠、可拖宽的侧边栏中，默认关闭；媒体卡片隐藏文件名，详情按钮移到操作行左侧。
highlights.en: Timeline and alphabet rulers now sit in a collapsible, resizable sidebar that is closed by default; media cards hide filenames and place the details button on the left.

highlights.zh: 首页、相册和文件管理新增当前任务按钮，可查看索引、查重、整理和缩略图等任务；任务期间页面不再被进度遮罩挡住。
highlights.en: Added a Current Tasks button to Home, Album, and File Management for indexing, duplicate checks, organization, thumbnails, and more, without progress masks blocking page content.

highlights.zh: 任务列表显示具体进度和剩余数量，支持暂停、恢复、停止；只有系统管理员或对应仓库管理员可以操作。
highlights.en: Task lists show detailed progress and remaining counts with pause, resume, and stop controls restricted to system administrators and the relevant repository administrators.

highlights.zh: 相册设置可开启新文件自动生成缩略图，也可手动扫描缺少缩略图的图片和视频；清理按钮统一改为清理无效缩略图。
highlights.en: Album Settings can automatically generate thumbnails for new files or manually scan images and videos missing thumbnails; cache maintenance is now labeled Clean Invalid Thumbnails.

highlights.zh: 缩略图队列增加处理中去重和准确剩余数量，同内容文件继续复用缩略图，保存、生成和清理按钮样式统一。
highlights.en: Thumbnail queues now deduplicate active items and report accurate remaining counts, reuse thumbnails for identical content, and use consistent save, generate, and clean buttons.

highlights.zh: 支持仓库和用户重命名，缩略图尺寸统一到相册设置，并新增后端启动、停止和重启脚本。
highlights.en: Added repository and user renaming, unified thumbnail sizing in Album Settings, and added scripts to start, stop, and restart the backend.

rebuild_index_notice.zh: 本次升级无需重建索引。已有图片或视频缺少缩略图时，可在相册设置点击“生成缩略图”；历史记录缺少拍摄时间或地点时，可使用“补全缺少信息”。
rebuild_index_notice.en: No index rebuild is required for this upgrade. Use “Generate Thumbnails” in Album Settings for existing media without thumbnails, or “Fill Missing Information” for historical records missing capture time or location.

highlights.zh: 相册新增 YuNet + SFace CPU 人脸识别，普通双核 CPU 也能运行。
highlights.en: Added YuNet + SFace face recognition on CPU, suitable for machines without a dedicated GPU.

highlights.zh: 人脸识别队列持久化保存，全系统同一时间只运行一个任务，支持开始、暂停、停止并清空，重启后可继续处理。
highlights.en: Added a persistent, system-wide single-task face queue with start, pause, stop and clear controls, plus resume support after restart.

highlights.zh: 可自动将新增图片加入识别队列并自动去重，人脸识别设置仅系统管理员可见。
highlights.en: New images can join the face queue automatically with deduplication; face recognition settings are restricted to system administrators.

highlights.zh: 人脸数据支持一张图片对应多个人脸，方便后续按人物整理和检索。
highlights.en: Face data now supports multiple people in one image, laying the foundation for future people-based organization and search.

highlights.zh: 文件索引新增“补全缺少信息”，只处理缺少修改时间、拍摄时间或拍摄地点的记录，无信息的字段会写入标记，避免重复读取。
highlights.en: Added “Fill Missing Information” for index records lacking modification time, capture time, or location; empty values are marked to avoid repeated reads.

highlights.zh: 系统启动时检查全部仓库数据库版本，自动执行可靠迁移；迁移失败会回滚并停止启动，且不会在启动时扫描文件。
highlights.en: Startup now checks every repository database and runs reliable migrations; failed migrations roll back and stop startup, with no startup file scans.

highlights.zh: 首页新增更新日志入口，管理员打开首页时可自动查看新版主要改动，关闭后同版本不再提醒。
highlights.en: Added a Home changelog entry; administrators can automatically see new release highlights, with no repeated reminder after closing that version.

rebuild_index_notice.zh: 历史图片不会在系统启动时自动扫描或识别人脸。需要人脸结果时，请在相册设置点击“开始识别”；索引缺少媒体信息时，请使用“补全缺少信息”，无需为了数据库迁移重建全量索引。
rebuild_index_notice.en: Existing images are not scanned or face-indexed automatically at startup. Use “Start Recognition” in Album Settings for face results and “Fill Missing Information” for incomplete media metadata; database migration does not require a full index rebuild.

highlights.zh: 相册新增文件名和文件大小排序、字母标尺，并可隐藏标尺侧边栏。
highlights.en: Added filename and file-size sorting, an alphabet ruler, and an optional ruler sidebar to the album.

highlights.zh: 相册支持时间轴、图片/视频筛选、批量选择、媒体预览和详情侧边栏。
highlights.en: Added album timelines, image/video filters, batch selection, media previews, and a details sidebar.

highlights.zh: 文件索引新增修改时间、拍摄时间和拍摄地点，媒体详情可直接查看。
highlights.en: File indexes now include modification time, capture time, and location for display in media details.

highlights.zh: 新增系统管理员、仓库管理员和仓库成员权限，成员仅可浏览相册。
highlights.en: Added system administrator, repository administrator, and member roles; members can only browse albums.

highlights.zh: 首页和登录页支持亮色/暗色主题及中英文切换，接口提示随全站语言变化。
highlights.en: Added light/dark themes and Chinese/English switching on Home and Login, with matching API messages.

highlights.zh: 相册缩略图分辨率可配置，文件仓库与相册统一使用按需生成接口。
highlights.en: Added configurable album thumbnail resolution and a shared on-demand thumbnail endpoint.

highlights.zh: 系统新增时区设置和日志自动清理，可按保留天数清理过期日志。
highlights.en: Added system timezone settings and automatic log cleanup based on a configurable retention period.

rebuild_index_notice.zh: 历史图片/视频需要重新建立索引，才能补全修改时间、拍摄时间和拍摄地点；也可以使用“补全缺少信息”只处理索引中缺失的记录。
rebuild_index_notice.en: Rebuild the index for existing images/videos to populate modification time, capture time, and location, or use “Fill Missing Information” to process only incomplete index records.
